search.metaTitle: Find a doctor for a home visit
search.metaDescription: Search verified doctors by speciality, symptom or name and request a home visit.
search.title: Find a doctor
search.lead: Search by speciality, symptom, doctor or clinic. Every visit is a request: the doctor confirms it manually.
search.label: Search doctors, specialities or symptoms
search.placeholder: For example: fever, child specialist, a doctor's name
search.empty: No suggestions. Press Enter to search for this text.
search.error: Suggestions are not available right now. You can still search.
search.suggestionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No suggestions} one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}} available. Use the up and down arrows to choose.

filters.title: Filters
filters.modeHint: Clinic and video are shown only where a doctor offers them.
filters.invalid: Some filters in this link were not valid, so they were ignored.

sort.label: Order by
sort.nearestNeedsLocation: To sort by distance, share your location. Until then results are not ordered by distance.

view.label: View
view.mapGatedTitle: Map view is not available yet
view.mapGatedBody: Showing a map needs an approved map provider, so we have not added one. Here are the same doctors grouped by locality.

card.experience: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} experience
card.openSlots: {count, plural, one {# open slot} other {# open slots}}
card.rating: {average} out of 5 from {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}
card.manualAcceptance: You send a request. The doctor accepts it manually; nothing is booked until then.
card.bookDisabledLocation: Cannot be booked until the doctor's service area is listed

results.heading: Results
results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No doctors found} one {# doctor found} other {# doctors found}}
results.noLocationNote: Doctors without a listed location are shown last. Their service area is not confirmed yet.
results.emptyBody: Try another speciality, remove a filter or search a nearby city. We only list doctors whose details are verified.
results.errorBody: Please try again in a moment. Nothing has been booked.
results.gatedTitle: Doctor search is not connected yet
results.gatedBody: The live doctor search service is not available yet, so we are not showing any results. No doctor information is made up.
results.invalidTitle: This search link is not valid
results.invalidBody: Some search details could not be read. Start a new search.
results.nearestActive: Sorted by distance from your location: {coordinates} (±{accuracy} m). Your location is not saved.

profile.feeNote: The final price is confirmed by the server when you request a visit and is saved with the request.
profile.availabilityNote: Slot information is a guide. The doctor confirms the time when accepting your request.
profile.notFoundBody: The profile may have been removed, or it is not open for bookings.

location.title: Your location
location.consent: If you choose, we ask your browser for your current location. It is used only for this search or booking and is not saved unless you confirm it.
location.requesting: Asking your browser for your location…
location.denied: Location permission was refused. You can allow it in your browser settings, or enter your city and PIN code below.
location.unavailable: Your location could not be found. Enter your city and PIN code below.
location.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again, or enter your city and PIN code below.
location.unsupported: This browser cannot share a location. Enter your city and PIN code below.
location.lowAccuracy: This location is approximate. Check it, or enter your address below.
location.pinInvalid: Enter a 6-digit PIN code that does not start with 0.
location.mapGated: Adjusting the pin on a map needs an approved map provider, which is not added yet.
location.confirmedDevice: Using your current location for now. It is not saved.

gate.incompleteTitle: {done} of {total} complete: finish these to book
gate.incompleteBody: A visit can be requested once these details are filled in.
gate.unknownTitle: We could not check this profile
gate.unknownBody: Your profile status is not available, so booking is paused. Nothing has been sent.
gate.notPermittedTitle: You cannot book for this person
gate.notPermittedBody: Booking for a family member needs their permission on their profile.
gate.gatedTitle: Profile check is not connected yet
gate.gatedBody: The profile service is not available yet, so a visit cannot be requested. No details are assumed.
gate.healthUnverified: Health details are kept in a separate record and stay unverified until a doctor confirms them in person.
gate.consentLabel: I agree to share these health details with the doctor who visits
gate.consentHint: Only the doctor assigned to this visit can see them.
gate.consentRequired: Agree to share health details to continue.

wizard.description: Send a request with your details. The doctor reviews it and accepts or declines. Nothing is charged now.
wizard.missingDoctorBody: Open a doctor's profile and press Book a visit to start a request.
wizard.notBookableTitle: This doctor cannot take requests right now
wizard.notBookableBody: The doctor has no open times or no listed visit area. Choose another doctor.

service.title: Doctor and visit
service.feeNote: Set by the doctor. The price is fixed when you send the request.
service.manual: The doctor accepts each request by hand. You will see their answer on the request page.

location.title: Where should the doctor visit?
location.intro: This doctor visits addresses in PIN {pin}, {city}.
location.chooseCovered: Choose an address in PIN {pin}, or add one.
location.localityHint: For example, the colony or street name. Do not add phone numbers.

errors.label: Choose a label.
errors.locality: Enter the area or locality (2 to 80 characters).
errors.pin: Enter a 6-digit PIN code that does not start with 0.

schedule.title: Choose a time
schedule.timezone: Times are India time (IST). Each visit is booked for one hour.
schedule.emptyTitle: No open times in the next 5 days
schedule.emptyBody: Try again later or choose another doctor.
schedule.changedTitle: That time is no longer available
schedule.changedBody: The time or fee changed while you were booking. Choose a time again.

details.title: Anything the doctor should know?
details.label: Symptoms or reason for the visit (optional)
details.hint: Keep it short, up to {max} characters. Only the doctor you book sees it. Do not add ID numbers or card details.

paymentPolicy.title: Fee and cancellation
paymentPolicy.feeNote: Set by the doctor and fixed when you send the request.
paymentPolicy.cancellationValue: Free to cancel or change up to {hours} hours before the visit.
paymentPolicy.syntheticPolicyBody: This cancellation policy is sample data for testing. It is not an approved policy.
paymentPolicy.payAfter: Pay the doctor after the visit
paymentPolicy.payAfterHint: Cash or UPI directly to the doctor. You pay nothing now.
paymentPolicy.onlineDisabled: Online payment is not available yet.
paymentPolicy.accept: I accept the fee and the cancellation policy.
paymentPolicy.acceptRequired: Accept the fee and the cancellation policy to continue.
paymentPolicy.changedBody: The fee or policy changed. Review it and accept again.

review.title: Review and send
review.manual: Sending a request does not book the visit yet. The doctor accepts or declines it.
review.confirmRequired: Confirm the details to send the request.

result.title: Request sent
result.uncertainTitle: We could not confirm your request
result.uncertainBody: The connection dropped while sending. Check again before sending a new request, so you do not book twice.
result.differsTitle: Your request was saved with different details
result.differsBody: Open the request to see what the doctor received.

request.title: Visit with {name}
request.noReference: You get a reference number when the doctor accepts.

requested.title: Waiting for {name} to answer
requested.body: The doctor reviews each request by hand. Their answer appears here. Use Check for updates to see it.

confirmed.title: {name} accepted your request
confirmed.body: Your visit is confirmed. Pay the doctor after the visit.

declined.title: {name} could not take this request
declined.body: You have not been charged. Choose another doctor or time.

completed.title: Visit completed
completed.body: Thank you. Your receipt is below once payment is recorded.

request.feeNote: Fixed when you sent the request.
request.payAfter: Pay the doctor after the visit
request.onlineDisabled: Online payment is not available yet.
request.changesClosed: Changes close {hours} hours before the visit. Contact support if you need help.
request.policySummary: Free to cancel up to {hours} hours before the visit. Sample policy for testing.
request.rescheduleNote: The doctor needs to accept the new time again.
request.noSlots: No other open times in the next 5 days.
request.moved: New time sent. Waiting for the doctor to accept.
request.receiptLater: A receipt is issued after you pay the doctor.

receipt.heading: Receipt for {reference}
receipt.methodValue: Paid to the doctor after the visit
receipt.notInvoice: This receipt confirms payment to the doctor. It is not a tax invoice.
receipt.notIssuedBody: A receipt is issued after the payment is recorded.
